limits: This is a sample of the BR_REPORTING table pulled on one date, not the whole table.
BR_REPORTING is an annual filing, typically 12-18 months lagged at publication.

Eligibility here means 'a receiver in this same sample has recorded recovery-type receipt history for this exact federal waste code' -- necessary, not sufficient, for the row's waste to actually be diverted.
'Divertible' means 'passes this gate', not 'will be diverted' -- no permit, capacity, logistics, or cost check is performed.
